newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed markets closed for holiday.

text.p: Indian oil and oilseeds markets were closed on Friday for a Hindu religious holiday.
Sluggish export orders was expected to pile pressure on industrial oils like castor while edible oil will buckle under cheap imports, dealers said.
On Thursday, castorseed June delivery prices ended steady at 1,223/1,225 rupees per quintal.

Groundnut oil was unchanged at 340/341 rupees per 10 kg, but imported palm oil fell 1/2 rupees at 278/279 rupees per 10 kg on renewed offerings by importers and stockists following reports of a setback in the world market.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 514/515 rupees per 15 kg.
